description: This Java class provides static factory methods for various header value validators used in the Eclipse Ditto framework. The validators include checks for non-empty strings, integers, longs, booleans, JSON arrays/objects, entity tags, entity tag matchers, acknowledgement labels, durations, timeouts, and metadata headers. The class is part of a header validation mechanism, allowing composition of validators into chains.

classes.name: HeaderValueValidators
classes.description: Provides static factory methods for creating various header value validators used within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: getNoOpValidator
methods.description: Returns a validator that never throws an exception and accepts any input.

methods.name: getNonEmptyValidator
methods.description: Returns a validator to check that a CharSequence is non-empty.

methods.name: getIntValidator
methods.description: Returns a validator to check if a CharSequence is a valid integer.

methods.name: getLongValidator
methods.description: Returns a validator to check if a CharSequence is a valid long.

methods.name: getBooleanValidator
methods.description: Returns a validator to check if a CharSequence is a valid boolean.

methods.name: getJsonArrayValidator
methods.description: Returns a validator to check if a CharSequence represents a JSON array containing only strings.

methods.name: getJsonObjectValidator
methods.description: Returns a validator to check if a CharSequence represents a JSON object.

methods.name: getEntityTagValidator
methods.description: Returns a validator for checking if a CharSequence is a valid EntityTag as per EntityTag#isValid.

methods.name: getEntityTagMatcherValidator
methods.description: Returns a validator for checking if a CharSequence is a valid EntityTagMatcher.

methods.name: getEntityTagMatchersValidator
methods.description: Returns a validator that checks whether a comma-separated list of EntityTagMatchers are valid, based on EntityTagMatcher#isValid.

methods.name: getRequestedAcksValueValidator
methods.description: Returns a validator for checking if a CharSequence is a valid JSON array of acknowledgement labels.

methods.name: getDittoDurationValidator
methods.description: Returns a validator to check if a CharSequence represents a valid DittoDuration.

methods.name: getTimeoutValueValidator
methods.description: Returns a validator for checking if a CharSequence represents a timeout as a DittoDuration.

methods.name: getMetadataHeadersValidator
methods.description: Returns a validator for checking if a CharSequence is valid MetadataHeaders.
